request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the land of Naphath Dor
Ben-Abinadab kept his post
One of twelve who served the king
Supplying food for royal needs

[Chorus]
He had Solomon's daughter Taphath
As his wife in days of old
A bond of house and kingdom shared
In the quiet region's hold

[Verse]
Provisions sent to Zion gate
For the household's daily need
Duties done with steady hand
Under Solomon's royal decree

[Chorus]
He had Solomon's daughter Taphath
As his wife in days of old
A bond of house and kingdom shared
In the quiet region's hold

[Outro]
Taphath his wife, Ben-Abinadab
In the whole of Naphath Dor
